==Core Values/Beliefs==

* Life is precious ... being alive ... happy in the sun
* The Destiny of SolSeed is to take root amongst the stars (openness to audacious possibilities/optmism)
* Be starfarer now (openness to audacious possibilities/optimism)
* Presence ... mindfulness ... in the now
* Nurture body, mind and spirit ([[SelfLove]])

* We ALL are precious SolSeed (openness/welcoming differences) (community) ([[Empathy]])

* Acting Upstream ... like Buckminster Fuller's trim-tab concept ([[Wisdom]])

==Purpose/North Star==
To bring life even unto the galaxy

==Actions==
* Build a SolSeed village/society
* Touch every one in the speculative fiction world
* Become a player in the space industry
* Incorporate the SolSeed Society nonprofit to do or contribute to charitable work

===Targets (3 Years)===
Year Ending: 12/31/2012

Place: We can point to a SolSeed village

Resources: Yearly budget is $1 million

Industry: We are making money from something core to launching life to another world, eventually another star system
* Questions:
** What discipline? (rocketry, power beaming, biotech, water filtration, server farms in space?)
** Can it support people with reasonable confidence?
** Win prizes, Small Business Innovative Research (SBIR) grants?
*** Venture capital is harder

Vision: Our vision is clearly articulated in all core media
* Website
* Books
* Videos
* Events
* Blog? Facebook? Other Web 2.0 madness?
